summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend Playwright validation on preview URL for AI receptionist core flows. All targeted backend and frontend flows passed, including graceful chat fallback behavior and mobile no-overflow check.
action_items: No blocking defects found in tested scope; proceed with broader regression if additional features are introduced.
critical_code_review_comments: BusinessProfileUpdate requires full payload for inline edit persistence; PATCH-style partial update support is absent (not a failure for current UI flow but a maintainability gap).
No explicit input format validation for appointment date/time and phone strings beyond required fields; consider stronger validation rules to prevent malformed records.
test_credentials: Not required for this scope (no auth flows tested). /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but has no credentials.
seed_data_creation: Created test records via APIs: TEST_Agent Booking and TEST_Agent Lead in preview environment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest passed (6/6). UI automation confirmed workspace sections, chat send/response, booking submit, lead submit, profile inline edits persist after reload, and mobile viewport has no horizontal overflow (scroll_width == viewport).
rca of the issue: No product defects identified in requested scope. One script-level failure occurred during first Playwright run due to using JavaScript JSON.stringify in Python context (`name 'JSON' is not defined`), fixed by rerunning with Python-native print of evaluated object.
